description: SMS++ (SMS++ energy Blocks) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by Dipartimento di Informatica, Università di Pisa. SMS++ is a software framework for modelling and solving large-scale problems with multiple nested forms of structure. The primary application of SMS++ has been to energy problems and several specific components have been developed. Coverage: any. The fact sheet classes it as: in princople all short- to long-term optimization. Sectors: electricity, heat components partly developed, but extensible to anything. Resolution: time Multi year, geography any. Data availability is given as "some". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is LGPL-3.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
